tools.name: assess_ai_readiness
tools.description:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_services, assess_ai_readiness, get_firm_profile, get_wcag_audit, request_strategy_session, request_quote · Private data: claim_listing · Public sink: request_introduction, claim_listing, request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_services, assess_ai_readiness, get_firm_profile, get_wcag_audit, request_strategy_session, request_quote · Private data: claim_listing · Public sink: request_introduction, claim_listing, request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
